name: Contra Costa County Employment and Human Services (EHSD)
description: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for Contra Costa County residents.
fullDescription: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for Contra Costa County residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Medi-Cal applications, renewals and eligibility questions
- CalFresh (food stamps) applications and recertification
- CalWORKs cash aid for families with children
- Disability and Aging Services, including IHSS
howToGetIt:
Call the Service Center, or apply online at BenefitsCal.com. The queue opens at 8am Monday to Friday and is shortest early.

Offices: 4545 Delta Fair Blvd, Antioch · 400 Ellinwood Way, Pleasant Hill · 1305 MacDonald Ave, Richmond.
keywords: Medi-Cal, CalFresh, food stamps, CalWORKs, benefits office, apply, EHSD, Contra Costa County, Antioch, Pleasant Hill, Richmond
